context_and_flow.screen_type: Account verification screen on a mobile device.
context_and_flow.ux_intent: To verify the user's phone number via a One Time Password (OTP).
ux_patterns: The layout is minimalist and functional.
Primary brand color (Amazon yellow) is used for the primary CTA.
Footer content is densely packed with legal links.
Clear visual hierarchy with heading followed by input field and CTA.
No illustrative imagery; focuses on utility.
